dog.description_text:
🖤 Meet Ollie! 🖤

This handsome 2-year-old boy was rescued from Jamaica, Queens, and is now ready to find a loving family to call his own!

Ollie is as sweet as they come. He’s an affectionate little gentleman who loves being pet, soaking up attention, and, of course, enjoying his favorite thing… TREATS! 😻

He’s a wonderful little companion with so much love to give, and we can’t wait for him to experience the comfort and happiness of a forever home.

Ollie has already made his way to safety. Now he just needs someone to make him part of their family.

Come meet Ollie and let this sweet black kitty steal your heart! 🖤🐾
dog.name: Ollie
